tooltip.darkspawn.noah_helmet: The sea placed its crown upon Noah’s brow. Water breathing; underwater sight.
tooltip.darkspawn.noah_chestplate: Forged for the abyss and fury of storms. Strength and resistance in water/rain.
tooltip.darkspawn.noah_leggings: No trench too deep. No wave too wild. Swift underwater movement.
tooltip.darkspawn.noah_boots: The tides carry the chosen heir. Fall protection; surface glide. Sneak to dive.
tooltip.darkspawn.noahs_tempest: The storm bends to Noah’s hand. Sneak-use: select power. Cast/ultimate keys: Controls → Legacy of Noah.
tooltip.darkspawn.tideborn_conch: Heard in the deepest trenches. Use: summon/recall. Sneak-use: rest. Defeat recovery: 30s.
tooltip.darkspawn.legacy_of_noah: A gift for Noah, Heir of Poseidon. Use to receive and bond all six relics.
entity.darkspawn.thalassar: Thalassar, Steed of the Tideborn Heir
tooltip.darkspawn.noah_bond: Divine powers bind to the first wearer or user.
message.darkspawn.thalassar_controls: Thalassar: WASD to ride, Space/X for depth, mount ability key for Abyssal Dash.
